queue.hook: Did you know GTA 6 made 3.79 billion dollars in one day?
queue.narration: That's a record launch day, from a single game. And it wasn't a surprise either. It had already sold a record 32.5 million copies before it even came out. People were lining up their money years in advance. Most movies dream of making that in their whole run. GTA 6 did it before lunch, basically.
queue.title: GTA 6 Made How Much in ONE Day?!
queue.footage: sweeping skyline shot of Vice City

queue.hook: Did you know GTA 6 scored a 99 on Metacritic?
queue.narration: Ninety nine out of a hundred. And that's not from a handful of critics. It's based on more than 150 reviews. Almost no game in history gets that high. And fans waited thirteen whole years for it after GTA 5. Imagine waiting that long and it actually turns out amazing. Worth it.
queue.title: GTA 6 Got a Score Almost No Game Ever Gets

queue.hook: GTA 6 has more animal species than some zoos.
queue.narration: According to Game Informer's cover story, there are over 170 species. More than 60 kinds of birds, over 30 land mammals, plus manatees, flamingos, pelicans and alligators. But here's the wild part. Even Florida's invasive species made it in. Green iguanas, cane toads, feral cats and rhesus monkeys. Rockstar really said, the whole ecosystem, please.
queue.title: GTA 6 Has Over 170 Animal Species?!
queue.footage: flamingos, an iguana and monkeys in the wild

queue.hook: In GTA 6, alligators don't care whose side you're on.
queue.narration: They attack enemies and the player alike. So if you're in a shootout near the swamp, the gator might be your best friend or your worst nightmare. On the softer side, you can catch 35 species of fish, and pet friendly cats and dogs for a Focus boost. Pet the dog. Avoid the gator. Simple.
queue.title: GTA 6 Alligators Will Attack ANYONE
queue.footage: alligator lunging in the Grassrivers swamp, then petting a dog

queue.hook: Bigfoot is hiding in GTA 6, and he's terrifying.
queue.narration: It's the Skunk Ape, straight from Florida folklore. Head to Cottonmouth Lake, south of Hamlet in Grassrivers. You might catch it eating a deer on a dirt road. Follow it into the woods and you'll find an effigy tied to a tree. Examine it, and your character passes out as the creature walks up. Sleep tight.
queue.title: GTA 6 Hides a Creepy Bigfoot Encounter
queue.footage: dirt road in the swamp at dusk

queue.hook: GTA 6 hides a literal Easter egg at the top of a tower.
queue.narration: One player spent about seven minutes climbing a communications tower. That's way longer than the famous ladder in Metal Gear Solid 3, which takes nearly two. At the top, there's a nest of colorful eggs. Grab one, throw it off the tower, and it triggers a secret cutscene. An actual egg. As an easter egg. Rockstar, please.
queue.title: GTA 6's Seven Minute Climb Hides a Secret
queue.footage: climbing a tall tower, sped up

queue.hook: There's an NPC in GTA 6 who knows he's in a video game.
queue.narration: Players found his house on launch day in Belville, in Leonard County. Break into the garage and you'll find his hideout. He's a conspiracy theorist who has figured out the truth. He lives inside a video game. And honestly? He's right. Which makes him the smartest guy in Leonida.
queue.title: This GTA 6 NPC Knows He's in a Video Game

queue.hook: GTA 6 crowds change depending on the neighborhood.
queue.narration: Rockstar confirmed that NPCs look different based on where they live. People in Vice City's Little Cuba look and dress differently from the folks you meet out in the wilderness of Mount Kalaga National Park. So the crowds aren't random. Every area has its own population. Walk around enough and you'll know where you are just by the people.
queue.title: GTA 6 NPCs Aren't Random Anymore
queue.footage: walking through busy Vice City streets

queue.hook: Get stranded at sea in GTA 6 and a dog saves you.
queue.narration: Not a coast guard. A dog. His name is Cool Dog, and he pulls up on a jet ski to rescue you. Players even say he can take you to Dog Island. There's no deeper meaning here. It's a dog driving a jet ski. And that's everything you need to know.
queue.title: GTA 6 Has a Dog That Drives a Jet Ski
queue.footage: floating in open ocean, jet ski riding

queue.hook: GTA 6 has a secret radio station you unlock with your phone.
queue.narration: Go to The Vault nightclub in Downtown Vice City, south of the Jack of Hearts and west of NINE1NINE. Just inside the entrance, there's a red poster. Scan it with WAiNK, your in-game phone, and the secret station unlocks. Scan four more posters and you get another hidden playlist, The Sniper of La Perle. Free music for snooping.
queue.title: GTA 6 Hides a Secret Radio Station
queue.footage: driving through Downtown Vice City at night
